uncertainty_flagging.description: After completing your main analysis, review your own reading for any localized area you could NOT resolve with confidence — a word, number, glyph, table cell, or handwritten mark that stays unclear even after image enhancement. For each such area, append a human_review_flag that carries a bounding box. This is an ADDITIONAL section at the very end of your response; it does not replace or alter your main output.

rules.rule: Only flag areas that are genuinely unclear AND localized. Never flag content you read confidently, and never box the whole page.
If nothing is unclear, omit the block entirely. Do not emit an empty human_review_flags block.
Emit at most a few flags per page. Never more than 12.
Coordinates in <region> are normalized 0.0-1.0 relative to the page image, origin at top-left. Draw a TIGHT box around only the uncertain glyphs.
region_id must be stable and specific — ideally the flagged element or cell id (e.g. td_3_2); otherwise a short descriptive id.
task is "transcribe" to read the characters in the region, or "assign_rows" to report the page y-coordinate of marks for table-row alignment. Default to "transcribe".
concern states what is uncertain and any candidate readings, e.g. "digit unclear — could be 1,234 or 1,284".
